info.title: Signapse Market Data Gateway
info.description: Normalized market data HTTP contract. No client authentication is implemented; deploy behind the intended network boundary. Prices/volumes are decimal strings and timestamps are UTC. x-build-revision identifies the configured producer build; unknown does not prove a deployed revision. WebSocket /v1/stream is quote-only and is documented separately in the [WebSocket contract](https://github.com/dgminhtam/signapse-mdg/blob/main/docs/spec.md#websocket-stream-contract).

get.summary: Get latest quotes with per-symbol failures
get.description: Returns ordered quotes and errors. Unsupported symbols/mappings, unavailable providers and stale cached data are per-symbol errors under HTTP 200, even when every symbol fails. Database/registry failure affects the whole request and returns 503. Refresh failure may reuse a sufficiently recent quote from the same mapping, never another provider. For repeated query parameters the last value is used, except provider, which must occur at most once. Unknown query parameters are ignored unless explicitly rejected below. Custom parsing errors use HTTP 400, not FastAPI's 422 validation envelope. Dependency failures can return 503 before query parsing. This instance accepts at most 10 distinct symbols. Cached quotes are reused up to 10 seconds; on refresh failure they may be served up to 30 seconds old. receivedAt is gateway receipt time, not exchange trade time.

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Comma-separated canonical symbols, case-sensitive. Trim each item, discard empty items, deduplicate while preserving first occurrence. At least one nonempty item is required; the configured maximum counts distinct symbols after normalization.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Optional request-wide, case-sensitive Provider Identifier from the symbol's providerMappings. Omission selects its Default Provider. Empty/whitespace-only or repeated values return 400 INVALID_PROVIDER. Nonblank values are matched exactly, without trimming or case folding. An unmapped value produces UNSUPPORTED_PROVIDER (per-symbol in a quotes 200 response, otherwise HTTP 400). The selected provider never changes automatically on failure.

get.summary: Get historical and forming candle snapshots
get.description: Returns candles by openTime ascending in a UTC half-open [from,to) window. Without limit/count, from is required and to defaults to one captured request-time UTC. With limit or count, use from for a forward scan, to for a backward scan, or neither for latest history. Both boundaries with limit/count, or limit with count, are invalid. limit counts eligible timeframe slots; count counts unique actual provider-backed rows. Gaps, exhausted history or the bounded internal scan budget may produce fewer rows, including an empty array. No synthetic candles, cursor or partial-result metadata are added. Response boundaries describe the window scanned. Forming candles have complete=false; completed rows win when openTime coincides. Only completed candles are persisted. MT5 backward/latest count scans exclude future opens while retaining the requested cutoff and including an already-open forming candle. Boundaries need not align to timeframe opens; provider timestamps are preserved. before is unsupported and returns 400 INVALID_TIME_RANGE. Operational failures return 503. For repeated query parameters the last value is used, except provider, which must occur at most once. Unknown query parameters are ignored unless explicitly rejected below. Custom parsing errors use HTTP 400, not FastAPI's 422 validation envelope. Dependency failures can return 503 before query parsing. This instance allows at most 1000 slots per range/limit request or snapshots per count request. Range size uses a conservative slot count before session filtering. Forming snapshots have a 5-second cache TTL and expire no later than closeTime; failed refresh returns 503 rather than an expired snapshot.

get.summary: Resolve a historical price at or before an instant
get.description: Tries resolutions 1m, 5m, 1h then 1d, scanning two eligible slots backward per resolution. Selects the latest completed candle in the first successful resolution with closeTime <= at; returns its close price and open time as pricedAt. Natural/retention gaps and closed sessions may use a coarser resolution, but operational failure returns 503. Every attempt uses the same selected provider; no resampling or cross-provider fallback. Future at values return 400. No eligible candle after all resolutions returns 404. There is no public timeframe selector. For repeated query parameters the last value is used, except provider, which must occur at most once. Unknown query parameters are ignored unless explicitly rejected below. Custom parsing errors use HTTP 400, not FastAPI's 422 validation envelope. Dependency failures can return 503 before query parsing.

get.description: Reads persisted events only; does not query MT5 or trigger a refresh. Required UTC bounds satisfy from < to and select from <= scheduledAt < to. Events are ordered by scheduledAt, type and external event identifier (the suffix of key). CSV filters trim, uppercase, discard empty items and deduplicate; an explicitly empty filter is invalid. currencies and impact accept arbitrary nonempty normalized strings; unmatched values return an empty events array. All event properties are emitted; enrichment and unavailable upstream values can be null. key is type:external_event_id. Raw source HTML, internal IDs and history rows are not exposed. For repeated query parameters the last value is used, except provider, which must occur at most once. Unknown query parameters are ignored unless explicitly rejected below. Custom parsing errors use HTTP 400, not FastAPI's 422 validation envelope. Dependency failures can return 503 before query parsing.
